Verify Now Blog > Monthly Submission for PCBWay Monthly Submission for PCBWay by: PCBWay Apr 30,2020 <dynamic-value> <dynamic-value> Posted in Activities blog writing Submit for Publication Community contributors This event has now ended. We will be launching more exciting activities in the future. Thank you for your attention. PCBWay’s Open Source Community is a platform of sharing creative electronic projects and insightful knowledge for global makers. “Learning from each other and making progress together” is the community atmosphere we want to create. Now a direct channel to express your own ideas about electronics and receive feedback from the community is ready for you! Whenever you have some useful and practical tips on how to design or make an E-projects, or anything that you think should be discussed at PCBWay, you’re always welcome to post it at our community. Come and be a valuable partner of us! How to submit? There are currently 2 types of submission of your contributing articles. Type A: Submit articles at PCBWay You’re encouraged to share the knowledge about PCB design tips, software instructions, step-by-step tutorials, or any basics needed for new learners to get their first boards being designed. Just submit your article directly through the following form. [Submit your post] Content requirement: Project making and sharing, electronic technical discussions, and so on. Rewards: --PCBWay will reward contributors with $10 - $50 coupon & 400 - 800 PCBWay Beans within 7 work days. --Every “PCBWayer” will be awarded honorary titles (according to the number of published articles, popularity and quality, etc). Silver writer (N<5); Golden writer (5<N<15), 2% off for PCB orders Diamond writer (N>15), 5% off for PCB orders N=The cumulative number of articles contributed --Have the opportunity to be published in other large magazines/websites. Type B: Submit articles on other platforms You can also post the articles related to PCBWay on your own website or other open source platforms<dynamic-value> instructable, hackaday, hackster.io etc. Workflow: Share the articles on your social media (Facebook, ins, twitter, LinkedIn), then tag @PCBWay. ﻿Content requirements: ❖ Original content related to PCBWay includes but not limited to review, unboxing, project sharing, promotion, etc. ❖ Add at least one more PCBWay link. ❖ At least 3 pictures. Rewards: PCBWay will reward contributors with $10 - $50 coupon & 400 - 800 PCBWay Beans within 7 work days. (Credit points which can used to get free modules or coupons in Gift Shop). ﻿Note: 1.Plagiarism is strictly prohibited, and community encourages contributors to submit original content. When you submit articles to us, you retain ownership of the copyright, and you also grant permission to us to display and distribute it. In addition, you are responsible for the content of that article. 2.PCBWay has no responsibility for the content submitted by contributors. We don’t guarantee to the accuracy or completeness of content or the result of accessing and using information on our site. We shall not be liable to anyone for any damages resulting from information found on the articles, even if damages are the result of inaccuracy, error, omission, or any other cause. 3.The opinions expressed by contributors are their own and not those of PCBWay. 4.PCBWay reserves the right to unpublish or refuse to unpublish anything for any reason or for no reason whatsoever.
